public_rationale: The evaluation is one day after publication, while the forecast concerns the coming months. Same-day reports show losses, but they do not establish how much occurred after the statement or satisfy both components of the early-resolution rule. Earlier peak-to-date losses cannot settle a new forecast. No decisive early event is established.
limitations: No exact deadline or numerical loss threshold was supplied.
Daily percentage changes cannot isolate returns after an unknown publication time.
The available neocloud report is secondary evidence; the attempted primary Nvidia history was inaccessible.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Nvidia and the neocloud companies will get hit hard in the coming months, possibly days.
public_payload.original_horizon_text: In the coming months (if not days)

statement.excerpt: In the coming months (if not days) Nvidia and the Neoclouds will get hit hard.
statement.document_title: Breaking: Anthropic stock is crashing, and AI stocks have lost over 50% in 5 months.

our_interpretation: In this stock-market context, the plain reading is substantial further share-price declines for Nvidia and publicly traded neocloud companies broadly.
CoreWeave and Nebius are examples for examining the sector, not an exhaustive basket supplied by the speaker.
Losses must occur after publication; earlier peak-to-date losses cannot satisfy the forecast.
Hit hard means a clearly large decline beyond ordinary daily fluctuation. The speaker supplied no numerical threshold, so borderline results remain unresolved.
Coming months supplies a near-term horizon but no defensible final calendar day. The horizon end is left null rather than inventing a deadline.
criteria.support_condition: After publication and within the coming months, dated prices show clearly substantial further declines in Nvidia and broadly across a representative set of publicly traded neocloud companies.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After a justified interpretation of the coming-months horizon has elapsed, complete price records show that Nvidia or the neocloud sector broadly did not suffer the predicted substantial decline.
